questions.question: The ratio of the present ages of P and Q is 4 : 3. Six years hence, the ratio will be 5 : 4. Find the difference between their present ages.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Ratio of present ages = 4 : 3

Ratio after 6 years = 5 : 4

**Formula Used:**

Age = Ratio × common factor

**Calculation:**

⇒ Present ages = 4x and 3x

⇒ After 6 years = (4x + 6) and (3x + 6)

⇒ (4x + 6) ÷ (3x + 6) = 5 ÷ 4

⇒ 4(4x + 6) = 5(3x + 6)

⇒ 16x + 24 = 15x + 30

⇒ 16x − 15x = 30 − 24

⇒ x = 6

⇒ Present ages = 4x = 24 and 3x = 18

⇒ Difference = 24 − 18 = 6

**∴ The correct answer is 6.**

questions.question: The arithmetic mean of the observations 65, 41, 96, 44, 38, 30, 79, 90 and 21 is:

Arithmetic mean = Sum of observations ÷ Total number of observations

Sum of observations = 65 + 41 + 96 + 44 + 38 + 30 + 79 + 90 + 21 = 504

questions.question: A man saves 60% of his income. If his expenditure is ₹600, find his income (in ₹).

Given: Savings = 60% of income ⇒ Expenditure = 40% of income.

Expenditure = ₹600 ⇒ 40% = ₹600.

Income = 100% ⇒ (₹600 ÷ 40) × 100 = ₹1,500.

Savings = 60% of income, Expenditure = ₹600.

**Formula used:**

Expenditure = (100 − Savings%) × Income.

 Savings (60%) Expenditure (40%) Income Total = ₹1,500 

**Calculations:**

Expenditure = 40% of income.

⇒ ₹600 = 40% ⇒ Income = (₹600 ÷ 40) × 100.

⇒ Income = ₹1,500.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1,500 (Option 4).**

questions.question: What is the difference between the simple interest on a principal of ₹3,600 calculated at 15% per annum for 3 years and 14% per annum for 4 years?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Principal = 3600

Rate 1 = 15

Time 1 = 3 years

Rate 2 = 14

Time 2 = 4 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest = (Principal × Rate × Time) ÷ 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ SI₁ = (3600 × 15 × 3) ÷ 100

⇒ = (3600 × 45) ÷ 100

⇒ = 162000 ÷ 100 = 1620

⇒ SI₂ = (3600 × 14 × 4) ÷ 100

⇒ = (3600 × 56) ÷ 100

⇒ = 201600 ÷ 100 = 2016

⇒ Difference = 2016 − 1620

⇒ = 396

**∴ The correct answer is 396.**

questions.question: A person's income and expenditure are in the ratio 9 ∶ 5. His income rises by 60% while his expenditure falls by 10%. If his initial expenditure was ₹15,500, then what will be his final saving (in ₹)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Income : Expenditure = 9 : 5

Initial Expenditure = 15500

Income increases by 60%

Expenditure decreases by 10%

**Formula Used:**

Income = Ratio × Common factor

Saving = Income - Expenditure

**Calculation:**

⇒ 5x = 15500

⇒ x = 3100

⇒ Initial Income = 9x = 9 × 3100 = 27900

⇒ Final Income = 27900 × 1.6 = 44640

⇒ Final Expenditure = 15500 × 0.9 = 13950

⇒ Final Saving = 44640 - 13950

⇒ Final Saving = 30690

**∴ The correct answer is 30690.**

questions.question: One pipe can fill a tank in 4 minutes while another pipe can empty the tank in 8 minutes. If both pipes are opened simultaneously when the tank is empty, how many minutes will it take to fill one-quarter of the tank?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Filling time = 4 minutes

Emptying time = 8 minutes

Required work = 1/4 of tank

**Formula Used:**

Work = Rate × Time

Net work = Filling − Emptying

**Calculation:**

⇒ LCM of 4 and 8 = 8

⇒ Total work = 8 units

⇒ Filling rate = 8 ÷ 4 = 2 units/min

⇒ Emptying rate = 8 ÷ 8 = 1 unit/min

⇒ Net rate = 2 − 1 = 1 unit/min

⇒ Required work = (1 ÷ 4) × 8 = 2 units

⇒ Time = 2 ÷ 1 = 2

**∴ The correct answer is 2.**

questions.question: A sum of money is to be distributed among A, B, C and D in the ratio 6 : 7 : 17 : 19. If C gets ₹250 more than B, how much amount did A get?

Share = Ratio × common factor

⇒ C − B = 17x − 7x

⇒ = 10x = 250

⇒ x = 25

⇒ A = 6x = 6 × 25

⇒ = 150

**∴ The correct answer is 150.**

questions.question: If A : B = 4 : 6 and B : C = 7 : 12, then find A : B : C.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

To find A : B : C when A : B = 4 : 6 and B : C = 7 : 12:

Take the LCM of B's ratios (6 and 7). LCM = 42.

Adjust A : B to 28 : 42 and B : C to 42 : 72.

Combine as A : B : C = 28 : 42 : 72.

**∴ Answer = 14 : 21 : 36**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

A : B = 4 : 6, B : C = 7 : 12

**Formula used:**

LCM method to adjust ratios:

A : B = 4 : 6 ⇒ Multiply by 7 → 28 : 42

B : C = 7 : 12 ⇒ Multiply by 6 → 42 : 72

 A : B = 4 : 6 B : C = 7 : 12 
• LCM of 6 & 7 = 42 

**Calculations:**

⇒ A : B adjusted to 28 : 42

⇒ B : C adjusted to 42 : 72

⇒ Combine as A : B : C = 28 : 42 : 72

**∴ The correct answer is 14 : 21 : 36.**

questions.question: A train crosses two tunnels 2091 m and 1259 m long in 89 seconds and 63 seconds respectively. What is the length of the train?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

First tunnel length = 2091 m

Second tunnel length = 1259 m

Time taken = 89 sec and 63 sec

**Formula Used:**

Speed = (Length of train + Length of tunnel) ÷ Time

**Calculation:**

⇒ (L + 2091) ÷ 89 = (L + 1259) ÷ 63

⇒ 63 × (L + 2091) = 89 × (L + 1259)

⇒ 63L + 131733 = 89L + 112051

⇒ 131733 − 112051 = 89L − 63L

⇒ 19682 = 26L

⇒ L = 19682 ÷ 26

⇒ L = 757 m

**∴ The correct answer is 757 m.**

questions.solution:

Extra amount without discount = 747

Discount = Marked price × Discount% ÷ 100

Selling price = Marked price − Discount

**Calculation:**

⇒ Marked price × 12 ÷ 100 = 747

⇒ Marked price = 747 × 100 ÷ 12

⇒ Marked price = 6225

⇒ Selling price = 6225 − 747

⇒ Selling price = 5478

questions.question: A car travels 180 km at 60 km/hr and then returns the same way at 45 km/hr. How many minutes more does the return journey take than the departure journey?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Distance = 180 km

Speed₁ = 60 km/hr

Speed₂ = 45 km/hr

**Formula Used:**

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

**Calculation:**

⇒ Time for onward journey = 180 ÷ 60 = 3 hours

⇒ Time for return journey = 180 ÷ 45 = 4 hours

⇒ Difference = 4 − 3 = 1 hour

⇒ Difference = 60 minutes

**∴ The correct answer is 60 minutes.**

questions.question: A retailer offers its customers a 29% discount on its beauty products and still makes a profit of 12%. Find the cost price (in ₹) of a beauty product marked ₹896.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Marked price = 896

Discount = 29%

Profit = 12%

**Formula Used:**

Selling price = Marked price × (1 − Discount/100)

Selling price = Cost price × (1 + Profit/100)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Selling price = 896 × (1 − 29/100)

⇒ Selling price = 896 × 71 ÷ 100 = 636.16

⇒ 636.16 = Cost price × (1 + 12/100)

⇒ 636.16 = Cost price × 1.12

⇒ Cost price = 636.16 ÷ 1.12

⇒ Cost price = 568

**∴ The correct answer is 568.**

questions.question: A cylindrical pipe, open at both ends, has an external diameter of 20 cm and an internal diameter of 16 cm. If the length of the pipe is 35 cm, find the volume of the metal used in making the pipe. (Use pi = 22/7 )
questions.solution:
**Given:**

External diameter = 20 cm

Internal diameter = 16 cm

Length = 35 cm

π = 22 ÷ 7

**Formula Used:**

Volume = π × (R² - r²) × h

**Calculation:**

⇒ R = 20 ÷ 2 = 10 cm

⇒ r = 16 ÷ 2 = 8 cm

⇒ Volume = (22 ÷ 7) × (10² - 8²) × 35

⇒ Volume = (22 ÷ 7) × (100 - 64) × 35

⇒ Volume = (22 ÷ 7) × 36 × 35

⇒ Volume = 22 × 36 × 5

⇒ Volume = 3960 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 3960 cm³.**

questions.question: A class of 91 students took a physics exam. The average score of 12 students was 64. The average score of the other students was 77. What is the average score (rounded to one decimal place) of the entire class?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total students = 91

Students = 12, Average = 64

Remaining students = 79, Average = 77

**Formula Used:**

Total sum = Average × Number of students

Average = Total sum ÷ Total students

**Calculation:**

⇒ Sum of 12 students = 12 × 64 = 768

⇒ Sum of 79 students = 79 × 77 = 6083

⇒ Total sum = 768 + 6083 = 6851

⇒ Overall average = 6851 ÷ 91 = 75.2857

⇒ Rounded value = 75.3

**∴ The correct answer is 75.3.**

questions.question: Navya and Bhavya can paint a house in 50 days and 75 days, respectively. If they work on alternate days, starting with Bhavya, how many days can they both take to paint the house together?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Navya = 50 days

Bhavya = 75 days

**Formula Used:**

Work = LCM of days

Efficiency = Work ÷ Days

**Calculation:**

⇒ LCM of 50 and 75 = 150

⇒ Navya efficiency = 150 ÷ 50 = 3

⇒ Bhavya efficiency = 150 ÷ 75 = 2

⇒ Work done in 2 days = 2 + 3 = 5

⇒ Work done in 60 days = (60 ÷ 2) × 5 = 150

**∴ The correct answer is 60 days.**
